title: SiBench Station API
description: Generated by scripts/api/build.py from src/station_protocol. Rules: docs/STATION_API.md.

AccessType.description: A register's or field's access, from the SVD.
AccessType.title: AccessType

ApiMethod.description: A DUT control method with its signature and first doc paragraph.
ApiMethod.title: ApiMethod

ApiModule.description: A DUT control module (lpw.radio) and its methods.
ApiModule.title: ApiModule

ApiPackage.description: A DUT control package (LPW) and its modules.
ApiPackage.title: ApiPackage

ApiParam.description: A DUT control method parameter; default_repr is None when it has no default.
ApiParam.title: ApiParam

CaptureMeta.description: A finished capture's spec, start time and sample count.
CaptureMeta.title: CaptureMeta

CapturePage.description: One page of a capture: channel -> base64 little-endian int16 samples for [offset, offset+count).
CapturePage.title: CapturePage

CaptureSpec.description: What an ECA capture records and how it triggers.
CaptureSpec.title: CaptureSpec

ChipInfo.description: The connected chip: part, revision, family.
ChipInfo.title: ChipInfo

ConnectResult.description: dut.connect: the chip, and where the DUT was reached.
ConnectResult.title: ConnectResult

DutInfo.description: API doc dut.info: hw{}, rta{}, chip, revision. app{} holds firmware metadata when the DUT has it.
DutInfo.title: DutInfo

EcaSources.description: The ECA's channels and trigger sources.
EcaSources.title: EcaSources

EnumValue.description: A named value of a field.
EnumValue.title: EnumValue

Error.title: Error
Error.description: A JSON-RPC error object. `data.reason` is the Station API code; the rest of `data` is its detail.

ExecResult.description: Console and custom functions. result_text is None when the code had no value.
ExecResult.title: ExecResult

Fault.description: Why a position is faulted: a hardware error during an activity. sys.recover clears it.
Fault.title: Fault

InstrumentFacts.description: One bench instrument as sys.status reports it. activity is the instrument's own (waiting, capturing).
InstrumentFacts.title: InstrumentFacts

InvokeRes.description: advanced.dut_control.invoke: the result as text, JSON (when it is JSON) and type.
InvokeRes.title: InvokeRes

LoadPhyResult.description: dut.load_phy: the PHY, the function the service called, the overrides.
LoadPhyResult.title: LoadPhyResult

MemoryBlock.description: memory.read: `address` is the aligned start actually read; data is base64.
MemoryBlock.title: MemoryBlock

MemoryWriteRes.description: memory.write: what was written and read back.
MemoryWriteRes.title: MemoryWriteRes

NameInfo.description: A console namespace entry, for help.
NameInfo.title: NameInfo

PositionFacts.description:
One DUT position as sys.status reports it. activity: idle | executing ...; fault: set by a hardware error
during a run, cleared by sys.recover.
PositionFacts.title: PositionFacts

ProbeResult.description: dut.probe: can that address be reached? Never keeps or drops a connection.
ProbeResult.title: ProbeResult

PrsRoute.description: A PRS route: a signal to a pin over a channel.
PrsRoute.title: PrsRoute

PrsSignalCatalog.description: The PRS signals the chip family's module defines (sorted), and where they came from.
PrsSignalCatalog.title: PrsSignalCatalog

ReadManyItem.description: One register of registers.read_many: a value or an error.
ReadManyItem.title: ReadManyItem

RpcAddress.description: Where a DUT's RPC server listens; None in calls means "the workspace config's address".
RpcAddress.title: RpcAddress

SiggenConfig.description: What a signal generator is loaded with. The wire carries Hz; the GUI shows MHz.
SiggenConfig.title: SiggenConfig

SiggenConfigData.description: A signal generator config as a signal_generator op carries it: frequency in Hz.
SiggenConfigData.title: SiggenConfigData

StationStatus.description: sys.status: the release, every position's facts, the instruments, and who holds the station (if anyone).
StationStatus.title: StationStatus

StationTest.description: One test the station can run (tests.list).
StationTest.title: StationTest

Traceback.description: A Python error from station-side code.
Traceback.title: Traceback

WifiConfigData.description: A WiFi PHY config as a load_wifi_phy op carries it (dut.WifiPhyConfig's fields).
WifiConfigData.title: WifiConfigData

WifiTxParams.description: WiFi TX settings (only sent for TX).
WifiTxParams.title: WifiTxParams

WriteResult.description: registers.write / write_field (API WriteRes). value_written is the whole register value written.
WriteResult.title: WriteResult
